An ellipsis the block container draws (after an inline-block, or alone on a
line) is painted as Chromium paints the line's items: after the inline-block and its content (over its overflowing child, blue), over the background of a span it is in (green) and of a block after it (blue, a negative margin), under a positioned element (blue). The ellipsis has the block's colour (red), the text a span's.
